freeze.encoding: integer nanoseconds from header.stamp.to_nsec(); list hash = sha256 of comma-joined sorted ns

missing_raw_scans.definition: raw scans in the injected bag with no pose within the pairing rule; outside the paired cohort
missing_raw_scans.note: listed separately; outside the paired cohort

freeze.reference_definition: FULL clean-run cloud in its own world frame, no cap; every distance is a local 8-NN PCA point-to-plane distance

host_reproducibility.what: position agreement only; rotation was not compared, so this is not a claim of full determinism

converted_scans.what: converted = filtered copy of the same bag; only the /velodyne_points payload changes, every other topic is copied byte for byte

control_poses_out.what: unfiltered replay, used only as the reproducibility control for the host pipeline

host.isolation: private ROS master on a free port; the wrapper kills only its own PIDs

runner.path_note: repo-relative after commit; the worktree path was recorded at generation time

run_receipt.what: the C3 execution predates the committed runner: inputs, configs, binary and outputs are hashed and bound, but startup/exit records and the ROS parameter dump were not captured at the time
run_receipt.note: the runner is now committed and writes a per-run directory with every log, the input/config/binary hashes, the ROS parameter dump, exit codes and the output hash; a short smoke through it is recorded under `smoke`

smoke.what: SMOKE_NOT_FOR_NUMBERS -- 15 s clip through the committed runner, to close the execution chain, not to produce C3 numbers

superseded_by_ns_boundary.why: the float 6-dp boundary put the first injected scan in the healthy prefix; primary/subset/prefix were 445/259/133 and are now 446/252/132
superseded_by_ns_boundary.status: kept for the record only; do not cite

_meta.map_construction: each keyframe contributes a 250-point stride sidecar of its own scan posed by the condition's pose; this is NOT the host's emitted registered map

verify_bag.join_key: exact header.stamp nanoseconds, not sequence number

filter_audit.count_rule: per frame, full resolution, original row indices -- never the difference of two independently subsampled arrays

evaluation_region.definition: AABB of the frozen key poses and of the reference cloud, both in the clean frame

C0.label: REAL_HOST
C0.label_note: host poses as archived; contaminated scans; no repair

pose_pairing.rule: nearest <=20 ms, else interpolate across a gap <=75 ms, else MISSING

C0.reference_query_well_note: denominator is the 40000 clean-reference QUERY points, not the arm's map points; a different quantity from plane_distance.well_constrained_fraction

nn.tail_definition: tails over SUPPORTED points only; beyond the cap is reported as unsupported, never folded into a tail

patch.tail_definition: supported = NN within cap AND patch radius/plane-RMS ok

aux_point_to_plane_unbounded.note: AUXILIARY ONLY -- unbounded, a far-away query can score 0 here
